records.title: D5: strict full-write RHS/Jacobian callback boundary and guarded time stencils
records.body:
## Problem and change

The native direct-buffer and previous-matrix/fixed-sparsity APIs have existing contracts. This isolated D5 research adapter adds an opt-in **strict full-write RHS/Jacobian boundary**, a joint owned pair return, and bilateral represented-time stencil admission. It reuses D2/C21H/C21I staging/domain patterns and the existing Session/Transaction/cap/output hooks.

Input domains use integer bit ordering before FP-dependent work. Callback entry is charged before dispatch, outputs begin as NaN, and successful finite full writes return owned values only after pre/post runtime-witness checks. The adapter does not change production crates or the existing sparse API.

## Actual evidence

- **35/35 new Rust contracts PASS**: 30 gateway + 5 Session composition, each suite once.
- **729 manufactured points / 6,561 exact value comparisons / zero mismatch**; 49 fixed dyadic time stencils have observed max error0.
- Raw corpus794rows,170379bytes, SHA256 `cb64d9455289f183363749289038d6f250bf63e0ab95ea94cd51defa88d2ba21`.
- Corpus-only RHS828 / Jacobian730 / witness3168; forbidden callback entry0. Counts do not include callbacks in the35 contract tests.
- An actual finite `J+I` callback pair passes the interface and fails the derivative oracle. Finite output is not derivative correctness.
- The original oracle's short-array `zip()` risk is closed by an additive saved-schema validator over identical raw bytes. **Read `REVIEW.json` with `SCHEMA_REVIEW.json` via `REVIEW_BUNDLE.json`.** No callback or original-oracle rerun was used for this correction.
- Two complementary scoped reviews closed material findings; independent personnel remains NOT_RUN.

## Source, stages and preservation

Actual numerical source S1: `0c73202734a52f30e4214d455be0fa9c47d37e0f`.
S2 result publication: `3107693de084341129c47c592204225c9045aa2e`.
S3 publication: `8c2a18c2c4706056e9bf9c7132aae419b787e5b3`.
Append-only ledger L-0172 has169rows; the previous453263bytes remain an unchanged prefix. The ledger reproduction pin is S2 because it includes the additive schema source; this is explicitly distinct from the actual S1 execution pin.

S0–S3 phase archives and provider ACKs are recorded in `delivery/`. Library and Dropbox preservation is confirmed for all completed phase receipts. S0/S1 Drive uploads remain UNKNOWN_NO_ACK with zero duplicate retries; S2/S3 Drive uploads were not attempted after those unacknowledged calls. Local ZIP/payload hashes PASS; new-archive remote whole-byte restore NOT_RUN. See the final receipts for exact provider status.

실제 S3 metadata CI [run40156477518/job121058848743](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/actions/runs/40156477518/job/121058848743)는 **FAIL**입니다. Checker unit tests24개와 node/append-only ledger169행은 PASS, authority만 FAIL(56distinct/199occurrences)입니다. 파일별 분해는 D4 이전32/143, D4경로7/25, D5경로17/31입니다. D4의 이전 snapshot baseline38/152와 현재 D4경로를 구분했습니다. Checker/allowlist를 바꾸지 않았고 scoped science PASS를 CI green으로 표현하지 않습니다.

New D5 budget CLOSED35.626779343961594s/120s (16local computational children35.590950343961595s + Wolfram kernel0.035829s). Original toolchain failures, original figures and corrections remain preserved. Metadata/API/backup latency is separate.
